occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-Proof of DFPS background checks: 3  out of 9 staff files evaluated did not contain a elgible background check letter.

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: A person was observed in a classroom with 8 children, ages 1yr. to 2yr. providing direct care. The person does not have an initial background check submission on file.    Note: The person in charge asked the person leave the operation during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

The caregiver stated there were 12 children currently present.
